# M9-S1 (R-U1): logos lint applies the language-neutral rules to the Go
# packages of the main module, while logos build and plain go run no lint.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos lint fails on the dropped error in the .go file, reports no
# loGo/s-only rule for the bare go statement, and writes no binary.
cd dropped
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:10:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! stderr 'unsupervised_goroutine'
! exists dropped
! exists dropped$GOEXE
cd ..

# logos build ./... and go build ./... on the same module print no lint
# diagnostic and exit 0.
cd dropped
logos build ./...
! stderr .
go build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# //logos:allow(slop::discarded_error) silences the diagnostic.
cd allowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# logos.toml slop = "warn" turns it into a warning that does not fail.
cd warned
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

# correctness::infinite_recursion defaults to forbid but runs at deny in a
# Go package.
cd recursive
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:3:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! stderr 'allow_forbidden_rule'
cd ..

# The directive silences it in the .go file.
cd recursive_allowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# The same directive in a .lgo file fails with allow_forbidden_rule.
cd recursive_lgo
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:1: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
cd ..

# logos lint --json-diagnostics prints one record whose file ends in .go,
# severity deny (the Go cap), validated with jaq.
cd dropped
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cp stderr $WORK/gojson.jsonl
exec jaq -e -s 'length == 1 and all(.[]; .schema_version == "1.0" and .severity == "deny" and .rule_id == "slop::discarded_error" and (.file | endswith("main.go")) and .span.start_line == 10 and .span.byte_len == (.provenance.origin_expr | length))' $WORK/gojson.jsonl
cd ..

# The capped severity of a forbid-default rule is deny in the JSON output.
cd recursive
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cp stderr $WORK/gorec.jsonl
exec jaq -e -s 'length == 1 and .[0].severity == "deny" and .[0].rule_id == "correctness::infinite_recursion" and (.[0].file | endswith("main.go"))' $WORK/gorec.jsonl
cd ..

# A group configured forbid still runs at deny in a Go package, so the
# directive silences it there.
cd goforbid
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# A Go dependency module, not the main module, gets no lint diagnostic, even
# when named on the command line.
cd app
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos lint example.com/dep
! stderr .
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# Positive control: the same package of a workspace module, a main module of
# the build, is linted.
cd ws/a
! logos lint example.com/wsb
stderr 'b\.go:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ../..

-- dropped/go.mod --
module example.com/dropped

go 1.27

-- dropped/main.go --
package main

import (
	"os"

	"example.com/dropped/lib"
)

func run() {
	os.Remove("missing")
	go work()
}

func work() {}

func main() {
	run()
	println(lib.Name())
}

-- dropped/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/allowed

go 1.27

-- allowed/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- allowed/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- warned/go.mod --
module example.com/warned

go 1.27

-- warned/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "warn"

-- warned/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- warned/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive

go 1.27

-- recursive/main.go --
package main

func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- recursive/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive_allowed/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive_allowed

go 1.27

-- recursive_allowed/main.go --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- recursive_allowed/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- recursive_lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/recursive_lgo

go 1.27

-- recursive_lgo/main.lgo --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- goforbid/go.mod --
module example.com/goforbid

go 1.27

-- goforbid/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "forbid"

-- goforbid/main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- goforbid/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- app/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/dep"

func main() {
	println(dep.Name())
}

-- app/lib/lib.go --
package lib

func Name() string { return "lib" }

-- ws/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./a
	./b
)

-- ws/a/go.mod --
module example.com/wsa

go 1.27

-- ws/a/a.go --
package a

func A() {}

-- ws/b/go.mod --
module example.com/wsb

go 1.27

-- ws/b/b.go --
package b

import "os"

func B() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.go --
package dep

import "os"

func Name() string {
	os.Remove("missing")
	return "dep"
}
